column3: Retains father of Gilead rather than explicitly father of the Gileadites.
Repeats sons for each named family and repeats according to their clans.
Repeats before and retains the LORD’s mouth without explicitly naming Joshua as the giver.
Retains the measuring-cord image of the shares.
Retains opposite Shechem and to the right.
Retains going down and the plural outgoings toward the sea.
Retains they as the subject of touching Asher and Issachar.
Retains the inhabitants and the daughters of the cities.
Retains and rather than because and the collective singular Canaanite.
Retains the shift to singular he and him at the final verb.
Retains me and I, one lot and one measuring cord, and until now.
Retains the separate condition if the hill country is narrow and the collective singular Perizzite.
Names the sons of Joseph explicitly and retains the collective singular Canaanite.
The Hebrew uses the collective singular Canaanite and describes the mountain’s limits as its “outgoings”; BSB uses plural “Canaanites” and “farthest limits”.
